steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: This is what a Maniac turns into, being consumed by the overwhelming power and completely transformed into a monster controlled by Mania.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Those in SALVA are collecting corpses of the Corruptors and carrying out shady experiments in the hospital basement to gain the power of the Mania.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>The medical director, Iron</color>, is crazy about developing various forbidden surgeries to distort the minds of the Syndicans with Mania to brainwash them.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: SALVA's obsession with Mania is an open secret among the Syndicate gangs. Since they work with Suspect R to spark off this massive Mania plague, they must be trying to obtain greater power.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You keep calling Sinners monsters, culprits who spread Mania.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm a Sinner too. Are you gonna explode if I bite you?

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: ...How annoying. I offered to work together not so that a Sinner can give me attitude.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: You should discipline her, Chief. Stop her barking around. Otherwise, even your lapdog will be gotten rid of.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm no one's lapdog! None of us are!
Hella is infuriated and smashes her steel pipe at Ted, who shows no fear but only a murderous look.
A chill runs down your spine as you recall the grenade that blew up the ambulance.
His men are already here. The guns must be aimed right at you and Hella!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Mmm!!
The moment you speak, you feel a burn in your hands, while red beams shoot out of Hella's skin branded with shackles like spikes.
She wails and falls to her knees as if she is drained of all strength, looking at you in shock.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Is this power...?!!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ow... It hurts... This again... What did you do? What did you jerk do to me again?!!!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Sinners can never defy their master's order.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella, never try to disobey the Chief.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: You can suppress Sinners completely. This isn't any ordinary technology... What is it...

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: ...Chief, I was wrong to say you can't keep you men disciplined. What a surprise you are.
You are in a dangerous situation and can't afford to start a fight with him here. You have to leave first. You extend your hand to Hella.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Sorry, but it's for your own good.
Now isn't the time for a fight.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Get out of here!
She slaps your hand away and shoots you a glare filled with hatred before struggling to get up herself.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I don't want to follow your orders. I'm not your lapdog! One day, I will kill you and break free! One day!!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Sob... Bastards... Go to hell... Go to hell, all of you... Sob...
She uses the steel pipe as her support and hobbles away.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Please follow me, Chief. My subordinates have come to meet you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: What about the SALVA men? Didn't you say they would leak intel?

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: The Chief wants to spare his life, and I respect the Chief's wishes.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: Besides... he isn't able to do anything now.

Above the ruins, the only surviving doctor dips his knees in a pool of blood, making his last futile efforts to bandage the girl. She can only lie there in her white robe soaked in blood, which stained the doctor's eyes.
You can't hear what he's muttering. His stiff hands are constantly working, while he looks like he can be crying or laughing.
